name: Saurian Claw Succulent
description: A succulent shaped like the paw of a great animal.
fullDescription: A succulent shaped like the paw of a great animal.\nIt is said that there was a time when the plants that grew here could shapeshift at will, almost as if they were some kind of enigmatic dragons. Some would appear poisonous or dangerous in other ways to avoid being eaten by herbivores. If this is indeed true, it is not hard to understand why the Saurian Claw Succulent — true to its name — came to take on the form it still has today.
sources: Recommendation: Found in the Sulfurous Veins
